intro: Felstone Field is a blighted farmstead located in the northwestern Western Plaguelands. Once a thriving piece of Lordaeron agricultural land, it has been claimed by the Scourge and anchored by a plague cauldron spewing toxic fumes across the ruined soil.

p: Before the Third War, Felstone Field was a peaceful, productive family farm feeding the citizens of Lordaeron. When the plague swept through the north, the homestead fell swiftly to the Cult of the Damned and the Scourge. Today, the fields sprout dead weeds and creeping rot instead of grain. At the heart of the farmland sits an enormous plague cauldron, continuously churning foul vapors into the sky under the watch of Cauldron Lord Bilemaw and legions of skeletal flayers, sorcerers, and ravenous ghouls.
